- [HIGH] Inbox item marked Processed with failed Notion link (Rule I39, I44)

  Affected: Inbox item and target Notion record (cross-layer / Notion).

  Evidence: Task Q is linked to a Stage whose parent Project does not match Task Q's Project.
  Affected: Task Q, its Stage, and both Projects (Notion).
  Effect: Broken hierarchy and split ownership/rollups across Projects.
  Smallest safe repair options (need confirmation): Confirm the intended owning Project and Stage for Task Q, then update only the single mismatched relation (Q's Project or Q's Stage).

  Evidence: Native Project property is repeated as metadata inside the page body.

  Effect: Drift risk if the native relation changes while body metadata stays stale.
  Smallest safe repair options (need confirmation): Keep the native Project property as sole truth; remove only the redundant body metadata line (preserving all substantive narrative) in a bounded authorized edit. Safe to defer past the review.
